messages.subject: BAMI
parts:
Hello all,

I did a Bayesian measurement invariance analysis.
Everything looks good when comparing the models using Loo based elpd.
I used noninformative priors and did not use "wiggle."
Is this still considered a BAMI.
If not, is there there a more formal name for Bayesian measurement invariance.

Best,
Miguel

messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: BAMI
parts:
Dear Miguel

Would be called "approximate" when you use wiggle. Otherwise, it would be just Measurement Invariance

take care
